about_the_role: Orbit Technologies builds logistics software used by mid-size carriers. Engineers here own features end to end and are expected to write code that other engineers can safely change a year later.
responsibilities: Design, build and maintain features across backend services and internal tools.
Write unit and integration tests that protect behaviour during refactoring.
Participate in code review, giving and receiving constructive technical feedback.
Debug production issues by reading logs, reproducing failures and writing regression tests.
Break large requirements into small, reviewable and independently shippable changes.
Work in an Agile team with sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
required_skills: Strong command of Data Structures and Algorithms with the ability to reason about time and space complexity.
Solid Object-Oriented Programming skills and understanding of clean code principles.
Proficiency in at least one of Python, Java or JavaScript.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
Disciplined use of Git for version control, branching and pull requests.
Experience writing automated tests, whether unit testing or integration testing.
preferred_skills: Familiarity with System Design concepts such as caching, load balancing and scalability.
Experience with Docker and containerised local development.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
Comfort working on Linux and with shell scripting.
Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery practices.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Evidence of programming ability through projects, internships or competitive programming.
